question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you have a copy of Surviving High School, the novel?
Who did you want to be Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of course! The Precious Puppy!
Amanda starts a bounding run that turns into three energetic cartwheels...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The Pretty Unicorn!
She follows her first move up with four graceful spins, her arms and legs moving in harmony...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The Cuddly Kitty!
And at last, Amanda dashes over the grass, leaps into the air, and arcs into two spins before landing solidly on the ground!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love cheerleading!
For the rest of the afternoon, the cheerleaders clean cars and collect money.
At the end of the afternoon, Nicole and the other cheerleaders huddle.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So how much did you get?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: None of your beeswax, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Just know that it's a ton! We could get entirely new cheerleading uniforms out of it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not too shabby! Good idea, Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Thanks! But more importantly, did anyone get invited to any good parties? I got concert tickets and an invite to Lee's house!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Jacob's having a beach cookout next week!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: And Spencer and Owen say the football team's doing a thing in summer we could be invited too!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Too bad Owen's stuck on that stuck-up at Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But this was, all in all, a success, if I do say so myself.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't know if I can pull the same thing off, but it'll be fun to try!
Nicole focuses on washing more cars, but in twenty minutes, the line has dwindled. The cheerleaders pack up the car wash stuff and see their earnings.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How much did you get?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why do you want to know?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Professional curiosity. The last time I did a car wash, I made enough to outfit the entire team in new uniforms.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, this wasn't as good. I don't think we even have enough for `one` new uniform.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, this wasn't as good. I don't think we even have enough for [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] new uniform.

nodes.text: Nicole looks at the other cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Did anyone get any party invites?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I got invited to an ugly dog show!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Great... Just great.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, I thought it went great. It was fun doing a social thing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It wasn't a terrible idea.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It was good, but wait till you see what I'm doing.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I can't wait.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Heh. All right. Let's see these guys then.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Keith! Hector! Get your butts over here!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yes, your majesty?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Don't be snarky, Keith. You and Hector are going to wash Megan's car until it's really shiny, okay?
The boys set to work with Megan watching on in approval. Ten minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, this is a pretty good job...
She looks over at Keith and Hector and grins.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And a good view!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You're not too bad, Pom-Poms. If you ever need anything from me--

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Like concert tickets?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Sure. Let me know.
She climbs into her car and drives off. Nicole doesn't even have time to wave goodbye as more cars pull up to the wash!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Whoa, more `girls` are pulling in!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, more [color=#3b78e2][i]girls[/i][/color] are pulling in!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I can't believe using Keith and Hector actually worked!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's my perfectly coiffed hair! No one can resist.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ha ha. I guess not.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Really? The best way to clean my car is with sponges? `That's` original.
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? The best way to clean my car is with sponges? [color=#3b78e2][i]That's[/i][/color] original.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What? Are you going to use `soap` too? Or have you never heard of that?
nodes.text_bbcode: What? Are you going to use [color=#3b78e2][i]soap[/i][/color] too? Or have you never heard of that?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Forget it, Pom-Poms, I'm out of here.
Megan drives away, and Nicole huffs.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Who needed her anyway?
Nicole blanks out!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Uh... Er... With sponges?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Next!
Nicole realizes the next car in line belongs to Megan. She tries to wave another guy's car over, but Megan gets out of her car and confronts Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Hey, redhead!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ack! Girl with a manbrow!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What was that?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Nothing!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I got a job for you to do.
Megan jerks her thumb at her car, which looks like it's been baked in mud.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Gross!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Look, Megan, I don't know if it's up to our `very` high standards to do a job like this one--
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, Megan, I don't know if it's up to our [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] high standards to do a job like this one--

nodes.text: Nicole feels a tap on her arm to see Maria. Maria pulls her aside.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, getting Megan on our side isn't a bad thing for a car wash. She's connected to Auto Shop.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah, but she's so... Manly.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Maybe, but... Girls throw parties too.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Do you really want to go to a party thrown by Megan?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Rumor has it she's got connections to some pretty cool local bands...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I take it back. I would `love` to go to a party thrown by Megan.
nodes.text_bbcode: I take it back. I would [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] to go to a party thrown by Megan.

nodes.text: Nicole walks up to Megan.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So about your car--

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Forget it, airhead. I know what girls talk about when they whisper off by themselves. You don't want my business, I'll do it on my own.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No, wait! We weren't talking about you... We're talking about the best way to clean your car!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Oh yeah? How's that?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I mean, no offense, but your car is kind of old. It's probably better that it's not old `and` dirty, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, no offense, but your car is kind of old. It's probably better that it's not old [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] dirty, right?

nodes.text: She laughs, but Lee doesn't.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: My car's not a looker, but she's reliable.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm not saying that she's unreliable. But... Looks count for a lot, you know. If you were to say, go on a date with me, then I might not want a second one after seeing your car.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Which is why you should spring for deluxe.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You know what? I left my wallet at home. It was dumb. I'll see you around.
He speeds away, and Nicole sighs.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do you approach every guy like that? Because it's going to be hard to get into parties that way.
Nicole frowns at Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It was a miscalculation. I almost had him. And there are more boys and more cars in the world.
Nicole flounces away.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh, that was horrible!
She turns to the next car in line, forcing a smile on her face.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You know, the deluxe could do wonders for your life.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: A life-changing car wash? I'm intrigued.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, underneath all the dirt, I bet your car's real charming.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Yeah, she's not the newest car in the lot, but she's got a lot of heart.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Well, there you go. What's the point of having a car with a lot of heart if no one can see it?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You really want me to get the deluxe, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It'd really help us out.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: All right. But only because you were so nice.
Nicole washes Lee's car. On his way out, he stops to talk to her.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Hey, Nicole, I'm having a party this weekend at my dad's house. Would you and the other cheerleaders be interested?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You can come visit my car.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ha ha, I'll think about it. Thanks!
He drives away, and Nicole squeals!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: More money `and` an invite to his dad's fab house for a party? I'm on the up and up!
nodes.text_bbcode: More money [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] an invite to his dad's fab house for a party? I'm on the up and up!

nodes.text: She smiles as the next car in line rolls forward.
Finally, Jill dismisses them.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hit the showers!
The cheerleaders and Taylor walk back to the locker room.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Despite the fact that I'm going to be feeling this for a while... I think my abs really are stronger...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That was actually kind of fun!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It was a better workout than I've had in a while.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That was the point! I'm glad you enjoyed it.
Jill drops back to talk to Taylor.
Taylor leads the way as the cheerleaders hobble to the locker room.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, hold me! I feel nothing but pain!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We'll find our way out of this... Together.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I can't even stand up straight! Muscles I didn't even know I had are hurting...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I didn't need to know about them. Really, I didn't.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I just want to curl up into a ball...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Sorry, guys.
Jill runs ahead to talk to Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: What'd you think, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Solid work. I would have done better, of course, but you weren't bad yourself.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You pushed them when they needed to be pushed, and eased back when they needed that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All in all, not bad.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You certainly have the knack for command. Though you should probably work on listening to your team more.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So... It was a decent effort. Maybe with more time, you'll get better at those kinds of cues.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'd say you have a shot at being Head Cheerleader, but let's just see what everyone else has up their sleeve!
You are now playing as Nicole.
The next day, after school, Nicole has the cheerleaders and Taylor meet her in the busy parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Where's $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: She said she was 'eating with a teen'!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What? Is $ZOE dating again?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No. I was there. She said she's `meeting with a dean.` I'm not sure for what though.
nodes.text_bbcode: No. I was there. She said she's [color=#3b78e2][i]meeting with a dean.[/i][/color] I'm not sure for what though.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Whatevs. We'll have fun without her!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Okay, Nicole. Why are we in a parking lot? And why did you ask us to wear our swimsuits?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, it's not exactly summer.
Keith, in his swim trunks, applies sunscreen to his arms and torso.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Good questions. Listen up, peeps. Today, we're going to work on the most important thing a cheerleader can have...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sparkly shoes?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No... Social status! Has anyone noticed that our public appearances have been practically non-existent for like the last six months?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Where are the party invites? Where's our air time?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We're not on TV...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Not with that attitude! We're `cheerleaders!` Every TV show I've watched and every book cover I've seen has told me that we're supposed to be on top!
nodes.text_bbcode: Not with that attitude! We're [color=#3b78e2][i]cheerleaders![/i][/color] Every TV show I've watched and every book cover I've seen has told me that we're supposed to be on top!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: One thing that our awesome former Head Cheerleader Taylor did--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ooh, you're sucking up to me. I love it. Twenty points to Nicole!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: --Thanks! One thing Her Awesomeness did during her reign was make sure we were always doing something social!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm not just talking about lunch time! I'm talking about all the time!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We're depriving the school of our presence! Which is why today... We're going to show the entire school how much they miss us! By hosting a car wash!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: A car wash? But you can't just throw a car wash without planning for it!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sure you can! And besides, it's not completely unplanned!
She holds up a poster showcasing Nicole, Maria, and Jill in bikinis. At the top of the poster is the phrase '$8 Car Wash - After School! Cheerleaders! Bikinis! Need we say more?'

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Um... Where did you get that picture?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: We're showing a lot of... Skin.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Obviously! That's the whole point! And that's exactly why we have all those people wanting us to wash their cars!
Nicole sweeps her hand at a line of cars on one side of the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: This is awesome, right?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Okay, so the plan is to have this car wash, flirt with all the hot guys, and then get invited to their parties this weekend. Everyone, got it?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Wait, so where do Hector and I fit into all of this?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Someone has to actually clean the cars while we flirt, right? Now shut up and help us!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: As Head Cheerleader, I say it's time to put those swimsuits to good use and start washing!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Dibs on the green car with the hot guy in it!
The cheerleaders fall to the task of washing cars with boundless enthusiasm.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Hey Spencer! Car wash?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Jacob! Your car looks like it could use some love.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha, that's why I'm here...
Nicole walks over to a car and smiles flirtatiously at the guy inside.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Lee! It's nice to see you here!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Nice to see you, Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So what's a guy like you doing in a parking lot like this?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I'm just a guy trying to get home from school. I'm glad I saw the signs for this though. My old man was bugging me to give this car a good wash.
Lee pats the metal just under his window fondly.
Nicole looks over the aging green car that he's driving. There's dirt everywhere on the car, and it doesn't hide the discolored panel at the rear of the car.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What a junker!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: It's not much, but she gets me around. So what's the going rate?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: $8 for the basic wash. But hey, there's a good deal on the deluxe wash for $12.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We use double the soap!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Basic's fine, I think.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Are you sure I can't convince you otherwise?
Nicole sizes him up.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I can't... I can't move!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda and I are still stuck here!
Maria pushes both Amanda and Hector over to help them.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We're doing more? The team is exhausted!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I said it, and I'm Head Cheerleader, aren't I?
They undergo another brutal exercise before Jill lets them stretch out. As the cheerleaders lie down on the grass

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ow... Is it normal for your legs to be numb?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'm just going to sit here... And not walk for a week...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh, thank goodness! The team is exhausted!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Sit on the grass. We'll start with hamstrings!
Jill leads them through several stretching exercises, including having them flop on their backs in the grass in the sun.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ahhh... This is the life...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Stretching is like heaven for legs.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Mmm-hmmm.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Don't get too comfortable! This is a working stretch! Make those legs longer! Make your splits split!
Jill can't decide!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Uh... It's time to, uh... Work out more!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So... What's, huff huff, up next, Jill?
Jill looks at the clipboard she's holding.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I'd planned at least one more exercise... Should I push them or stop now?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: You've done running, planks, push-ups, toe-touches, lunges, and sit-ups...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Now it's time to...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Ten more to go! 10... 9... 8...
Jill sees the looks on everyone's faces set with determination as they power through the last of the lunges.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Urgh!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: And 1! Put those weights away!
Jill sees everyone sag with exhaustion as they struggle through the last of the lunges. Several stop doing their lunges entirely.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Oof.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: And 10! Put those weights away!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Forget doing it her way. I'm the Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Keep working on it! You're almost there!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Ugh! Huff! It! Hurts!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: There's ten more left...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: These exercises will make you feel better as a human being!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's hard to, huff huff, envision that... When you're about to die!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: My legs are so shaky they make gelatin look stable!
Amanda lunges forward and doesn't get back up.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm stuck!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm coming, Manda-Panda!
Hector tries to help her up, but they both get stuck in that position.
Maria nearly drops her weight.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What was that about bikinis?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Everything you're doing now is helping you get ready for summer! Lunges, planks, and push-ups will make your bikini body hotter!
Maria and Nicole smile at this.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I love being hot!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Thinking of a new bikini is much better than thinking about doing a stupid lunge.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I don't wear bikinis.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yeah, but you look at them. Surely you can appreciate the mental image.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Well, sure...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Uh... Your health!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Go ahead. Tell me all your problems.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's just the one. We want a leader to unify the entire group. We tried a cheer-ocracy--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: --but it's been unsuccessful. We want to elect a new Head Cheerleader. But the question is, how do we determine who's the best fit for the job?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I got it. All of you are going to compete for the title of Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's exactly like that nerdy book about thrones that Brendan was telling me about...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I've always wanted a throne!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So how exactly are we going to compete again?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: By trial run.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Everyone who wants to be Head Cheerleader gets to show how they'd lead the squad by hosting an event, and whoever has the best event wins!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And how are we going to determine the winner exactly? Voting's never been--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Pfft! Who ever said anything about voting? `I'll` decide after everyone's had their chance.
nodes.text_bbcode: Pfft! Who ever said anything about voting? [color=#3b78e2][i]I'll[/i][/color] decide after everyone's had their chance.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How will you know who to pick?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Easy. The Head Cheerleader will be the one person with the clearest vision `and` the ability to carry out that vision.
nodes.text_bbcode: Easy. The Head Cheerleader will be the one person with the clearest vision [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] the ability to carry out that vision.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Planning and execution. It's what leaders do. I'll know it when I see it at the events.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...In fact, I'll attend all these events with you, so `I` have all the information necessary to choose the `best` Head Cheerleader!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...In fact, I'll attend all these events with you, so [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] have all the information necessary to choose the [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You're going to attend all the events?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I thought you said your time was very valuable.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, but I can't pass up the chance to judge people! Don't worry! You won't even notice me. I'll just be a quiet, passive observer in the back.
Taylor claps her hands twice, and Justin walks into the room.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You don't really have to do that. I can hear what's going on in here.
Taylor claps twice again.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `Sigh...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Sigh...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Justin walks out and then walks back in, but silently this time.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, Justin. Move my meetings back! Finish all my paperwork! I'm going to interact with my subjects.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You don't have any mee--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Justin!
Taylor holds up her hands, ready to clap!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yes, Madame President.
Taylor turns to the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We start in twenty minutes! Who wants to go first?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! I can't! I'll never find a unicorn in time!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Amanda, you're not doing the trial run...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh yay!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'll go tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I'll go after that!

nodes.text: I've crafted a special workout schedule for us as a team, and today, we'll be doing one of those workouts!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know, huff huff, Jill... This workout will be good for us, but maybe you should try taking it easier? Or giving us something... `Inspiring` to think about?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huff, huff... `Mountain goats` aren't this conditioned.
nodes.text_bbcode: Huff, huff... [color=#e23b3b][i]Mountain goats[/i][/color] aren't this conditioned.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Just keep it in mind, okay?

nodes.text: And you know, Jill... When I work out, I usually count `down` during the last ten of a set. When you count down instead of up, it makes it feel like what you have to do is smaller. It's subtle, but the team will appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: We're going to work on legs now... I have some weights in the bag that I brought. Grab a ten-pounder and start on alternating lunges!

nodes.text: Listen, Taylor, standards on the cheerleading team have slipped since you left. To put it simply, life just isn't as good.

nodes.text: `Video games!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Video games![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The cheerleaders pile into the den and crowd around Keith's huge TV where a fighting game is on screen.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: 'Battle Brawl 6'? No way! This is amazing! How do you have this?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: My dad's in the game industry. He gets games early.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Okay, before you geeks start freaking out over there, what are we suposed to do while you two play?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's a four-player game. Hector and I can rotate in and out.
They get to playing. It's clear Keith and Hector have the upper-hand as their characters hack, slash, and cut through everyone else's!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Maria and Lindsay's characters are KO'd! Jill and Nicole you're up!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...Do we really have to?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Uh, yeah! Unless you're afraid. I know I'm up at ten wins to nothing--

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, I knocked your guy out that one round.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: --Sure. Make that nine wins to one.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I'm not scared! And I'll show you.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: It's not like we're going to be doing anything more fun tonight...
As the girls pick up their controllers, Keith looks around at the unhappy frowns on the other cheerleader's faces. Maria catches his eye.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, Keith, do you want to play another game? Something we're all good at?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What, you don't enjoy bowing down in the face of someone else's superiority?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't think we're questioning how well you play. But... I thought tonight was about `everyone` getting equal representation, not just you getting revenge for stuff we've done to you in the past.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think we're questioning how well you play. But... I thought tonight was about [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone[/i][/color] getting equal representation, not just you getting revenge for stuff we've done to you in the past.

nodes.text: Ignoring her, Keith shrugs and queues up the next fight in 'Battle Brawl 6'. Right as he starts the game, he pauses to think about what Maria's said.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hmm, maybe this isn't about making the girls do things that I like to do... Taylor said that it was about having a vision and sticking to it!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And my vision is to make sure everyone is represented... I want them to have fun.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: But how do I make sure Nicole and Jill have fun at something they clearly hate?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Keith! Wake up! We're in battle!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Huh? Oh yeah!
Meanwhile, the song on the speakers starts to wind down.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: The pose!
All the cheerleaders stop dancing, run to the center of the field, and arrange themselves for the final pose.
Except for Amanda, all the cheerleaders stop dancing, run to the center of the field, and arrange themselves for the final pose.
Everyone tries to hoist Maria, Lindsay, and Nicole up on their shoulders...
But it's a disaster!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Watch where you're putting your hands, Keith!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: If you'd stop fidgeting so much, I could just hold on to your shoes like normal!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why are you wobbling?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm not wobbling! That's you!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Nothing on me wobbles! What are you saying?
Nicole tries to get down, but knocks Hector off balance! He falls into Maria and Jill!
Maria crashes to the grass, her skirt stained and her hair ruined!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Okay, that is it!
The other cheerleaders stop to stare at her as she crawls to her feet.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We cannot show up to the last pep rally of the year, looking like... Like this!
Amanda makes a sad face.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I did The Cuddly Kitty perfectly!
Hector puts an arm around Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I saw that you did.
From the ground nearby, Amanda lifts her head.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but I just couldn't remember the good in the world!
Hector puts an arm around Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The Evil Poodle really did you in this time, huh?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Those eyes! And that little fluffy tail!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I don't think it went `that` badly...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think it went [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] badly...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah, what happened? I did my part.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: And my front handsprings were perfect.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's not any one person! It's everything!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We're running into each other, and we don't look coordinated at all! Jill and Hector are tripping people up, and Nicole and Lindsay look like they're dancing in two different music videos!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And those are just the problems we've been having `today!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And those are just the problems we've been having [color=#3b78e2][i]today![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We've had more problems?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Well, for one, we haven't been showing up at the sporting events, and we haven't been invited to any parties. When was the last time people saw us cheering at an event?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And two, we never have full attendance at practice anymore!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yeah, $ZOE doesn't even show up half the time.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sounds like my last boyfriend!
Maria glares at Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sorry... You were ranting?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But it's not just $ZOE. The last couple practices haven't been perfect. Like that one time when everyone bailed, and it was just me and Keith?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey, that was a precious memory that I'm going to keep with me for the rest of my life.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Come on, guys. You can't tell me you're all one hundred percent happy with the way things have been going, can you?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I `did` want to do a better job this year of getting more of the cheerleading moves down.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] want to do a better job this year of getting more of the cheerleading moves down.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And we don't get as many perks as we used to. People barely even know who we are anymore. We `haven't` been going to as many parties.
nodes.text_bbcode: And we don't get as many perks as we used to. People barely even know who we are anymore. We [color=#3b78e2][i]haven't[/i][/color] been going to as many parties.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And the team is `way` too girly. I know Hector feels the same--
nodes.text_bbcode: And the team is [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too girly. I know Hector feels the same--

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, don't bring me down with you, man. I'm not a part of this!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Fine. But `I'm` sticking by what I said.
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. But [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] sticking by what I said.

nodes.text: The other girls give Keith a nasty look.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Everything's been going downhill, and I think I know why... It's because we don't have a Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I thought we decided against having one. We're a cheer-ocracy now. We vote on things.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We're a broken-ocracy is what we are. Our voting doesn't even work.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yes, it does!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How many people want to get pizza after practice tonight?
No one raises their hand.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How many people `don't` want to get pizza after practice tonight?
nodes.text_bbcode: How many people [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] want to get pizza after practice tonight?

nodes.text: No one raises their hand again.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Were we supposed to do something?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That's a trick question, Maria. Of course no one's going to want `pizza` right before the last performance of the year. We're still athletes after all.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's a trick question, Maria. Of course no one's going to want [color=#3b78e2][i]pizza[/i][/color] right before the last performance of the year. We're still athletes after all.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Surely we can decide on `something.` Like... How many people `don't` want to elect a Head Cheerleader right now?
nodes.text_bbcode: Surely we can decide on [color=#3b78e2][i]something.[/i][/color] Like... How many people [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] want to elect a Head Cheerleader right now?

nodes.text: Everyone raises their hand.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How many people `do` want to elect a Head Cheerleader?
nodes.text_bbcode: How many people [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] want to elect a Head Cheerleader?

nodes.text: Everyone raises their hand again.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I see your point.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We can't decide things as a group, so we have no vision. Which is why we can't make a routine that makes sense and looks good!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Who's going to be Head Cheerleader? Because I'd totally rock.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I guess we'll have to try voting on it. Let's do it now.
Maria rips out pieces of paper from her notebook and hands them out to people.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Write down who you think should lead our group, and then hand them in. We'll see who has the majority of the votes!
Amanda looks down, contemplating what to write.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: On the one hand, I know who I am...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But who would be the best leader ever?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's hard being king.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, but it's super fun.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: How am I doing?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not bad. Not bad at all.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There were some things I was impressed with.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do you really want to know?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: That bad?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maria was completely right. You can't say your platform's all about making sure everyone is represented, and then just go off and do your own thing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: For instance, a good leader knows when to make sacrifices. Nice job throwing games of Battle Brawl.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You could tell?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, come on. I'm dating Brendan. He's, like, Nerd Prime! You think I don't know when someone's pulling their virtual punches?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It made the game more fun for them. Trust me, it's not fun being a level 1 peasant when everyone else is a level 50 mage.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: That was a little too nerdy for me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really? Because someone's nails look like they could use a fresh coat of polish.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Erp!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But a good leader knows when to make sacrifices.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You're talking about how I kept winning all the games.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. Sometimes you have to play badly so everyone else can enjoy themselves.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah.
Maria walks up to Taylor and Keith.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Hey, Keith, the girls found a board game they want to play!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah? I'll help you set it up!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Thanks!
You are now playing as Maria.
At the dining table, Keith helps Maria and the other cheerleaders set up the board game 'Krazy Kingdom', dealing cards and unfolding the board.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So how do we play this?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: The rules to this are pretty easy. It's a timed cooperative game. We're all part of one kingdom, and each of us has a different role.
Keith picks up a small stack of role cards.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: There are six roles, and everyone needs to pick one. I'll describe what they do, and if you want it, say so.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Knight. You defend the 'Monarch'.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll take that one. It sounds cool!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It totally is. Next is 'Peasant'. You get to bale hay...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh, me, me!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: A lot of enthusiasm for such a menial position... But I'm glad you're happy.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And the next role is 'Monarch'. You get to make decisions for other people and decide the fate of your kingdom.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: This is my favorite char--
Jill and Nicole speak up at the same time.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I'll take it.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I want it!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Me too. And it `is` my game...
nodes.text_bbcode: Me too. And it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] my game...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Exactly. Which is why you should let one of us have it. Preferably me.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Why you?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Because in an actual medieval castle, I know which one of the two of us would be the stronger, and that's all that mattered back then.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What about being cunning and making alliances? Because I'm definitely way better at that than you!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: What is that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm saying that I'm more social than you.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I'm social! I'm so social!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I wouldn't know from the way you made all of us focus `way` too much on athletics.
nodes.text_bbcode: I wouldn't know from the way you made all of us focus [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too much on athletics.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Oh yeah, because `car washing` is `so` much better than perfecting an art.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah, because [color=#3b78e2][i]car washing[/i][/color] is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much better than perfecting an art.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Whoa, you guys...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Nothing is wrong with car washing!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That is so untrue! Cheerleaders get a bad enough rap without `Miss Bikini` here making it more about being bimbos than being athletes!
nodes.text_bbcode: That is so untrue! Cheerleaders get a bad enough rap without [color=#3b78e2][i]Miss Bikini[/i][/color] here making it more about being bimbos than being athletes!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, I'm doing you guys a service! The cheerleaders are supposed to be `cheer` leaders! And that means pumping up school spirit.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I'm doing you guys a service! The cheerleaders are supposed to be [color=#3b78e2][i]cheer[/i][/color] leaders! And that means pumping up school spirit.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: We can't do that if we're `anonymous!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We can't do that if we're [color=#3b78e2][i]anonymous![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Come on, Nicole, it's a little self-serving.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Don't you start! None of us on the team are as obsessed with hair gel as you are!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh, guys... We're getting away from the game here...
But Keith talks over her.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's not about the hair gel. It's about being treated fairly! That's what I wanted the team to be! A place where no one feels picked on!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah right! It's about `you` feeling like no one is treating `you` nicely!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah right! It's about [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] feeling like no one is treating [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] nicely!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Is that so wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yes! Yes, it is! You're not the only one on the team, Keith!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This is getting way out of hand! I need to do something!
Maria tries to get everyone's attention, but they keep arguing!
She...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A good leader knows how far to push people.
Taylor shifts to Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A good leader sees opportunity in everything.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And of course, Keith...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It might have been Maria...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And a good leader knows that keeping the people under you happy is the key to succeeding.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now do you get why I chose her?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yes... I guess.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Sure, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great! From this day forward, Maria is the new Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This is... This is amazing!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good luck.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So what's your first act as Head Cheerleader?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I have something in mind...
You are now playing as Maria.
Maria herds all the cheerleaders onto the football field for her first practice as Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Okay, guys... Remember that routine we were working on for the end-of-the-year rally? We're doing that routine again from the top!
Taking their cue from the music, all the cheerleaders start their routines! From the side, Maria barks out orders!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Jill, shift left and do your handsprings down the length of the football field! Amanda, same thing, but from the opposite side!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Keith and Hector, you're blocking everyone's way! Move your routines to the center of the field!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Nicole and Lindsay, you're both dancing the salsa! Flank Keith and Hector!
And in two minutes flat, the cheerleading team is successfully putting on a show!
Jill and Amanda do turns, leaps, and twirls around a flowing Keith and a breakdancing Hector, while Nicole and Lindsay salsa to the same beat!
At the end, the cheerleaders dance to the center and successfully hoist Nicole and Maria up on their shoulders!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: GO!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: FIGHT!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `WIN!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]WIN![/i][/color]

nodes.text: You have reached the end of `Season 6, Episode 2: Cheer Off!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 6, Episode 2: Cheer Off![/b]

nodes.text: Remember to join us on Facebook at facebook.com/survivinghighschool!
Or follow us on Twitter @SHSTeam!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Because frankly, you guys need to shape out and ship up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ship out and shape up?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: ...Whatever. The point is, you've slipped a ton since I was acting Head Cheerleader, and Jill's got the clearest vision for whipping you back into shape!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Thanks, Taylor! I won't let you down!
The next day, the cheerleaders gather for the first practice with Jill as Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Listen up, squad! This is how it's going to go down! The sectionals competition for cheerleaders is coming up in a couple months, and we `are` going to be ready!
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen up, squad! This is how it's going to go down! The sectionals competition for cheerleaders is coming up in a couple months, and we [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] going to be ready!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That means we work out twice every day! Before and after school! From dawn until dusk!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Every day? What about weekends?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: `Especially weekends!` Now, drop and give me fifty!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Especially weekends![/i][/color] Now, drop and give me fifty!

nodes.text: And so the cheerleaders train...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So... Weak...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hurts... So... Much...
And train...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Knee lifts! I want you to knee yourself in the face!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I can't!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ow, ow, ow!
And train...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Keep running! You've got two miles left to go!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Legs, gasp, falling, huff, off!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: This, huff huff, sucks!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Keep running!
And train!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Faster cartwheels, people! I shouldn't be able to tell where your legs and arms are landing!
Maria comes up to Jill.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Jill, we did really well at sectionals... Maybe we can take a break today?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: A break? Don't make me laugh! Sectionals is the first step. But the training isn't going to stop there.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: There's more, Maria... So much more!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Sectionals... Regionals... Nationals...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: And then the world!
Well, it looks like a regime under Jill is definitely intense...
And not much fun!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Her workout was awful!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I pick Jill!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What? But why?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: But we didn't do anything remotely related to cheerleading when she was fake Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: This isn't a Party Club!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Exactly. You guys `aren't` party club. But you should be!
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly. You guys [color=#3b78e2][i]aren't[/i][/color] party club. But you should be!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Because, frankly, you need to liven things up! You guys are boring, lame, blah!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You've become so much less fun since I was acting Head Cheerleader, and Nicole's got the clearest vision for putting you back on top!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Thanks, Taylor! You're the best! We're going to be the most social cheerleading team the school's ever seen!
Under Nicole's rule, the cheerleaders become a lot more social!
They run car washes...

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Nicole, this is our third car wash this week! Is there a dirty car anywhere on campus?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You know what they say, Jill... Another day, another car wash! But today we're doing things a little differently! We're washing the cars in `plaid` bikinis!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know what they say, Jill... Another day, another car wash! But today we're doing things a little differently! We're washing the cars in [color=#3b78e2][i]plaid[/i][/color] bikinis!

nodes.text: They have smoothie socials at lunch...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Come and get your smoothie! Smoothies for sale!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yummy, delicious, and happy smoothies!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: The Center Table's your one-stop place for free smoothies offered by girls in bikinis!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yes! I dreamed this day would come!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Why `are` we wearing bikinis for this again?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] we wearing bikinis for this again?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Just run with it, Lindsay!
And they even stage a bake sale at a football game!
During half-time, instead of performing, the cheerleaders walk down the football field throwing baked treats out to the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This is... Kind of weird.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kind of delicious!
Maria whispers to Nicole, who's walking in front of her.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It is strange we aren't cheering at these games... Isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Don't worry about it! Who cares if we're cheering? We're doing this for a cause!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And people love `us,` not the cheerleading team! We're like... Babes in bikinis with baked goods!
nodes.text_bbcode: And people love [color=#3b78e2][i]us,[/i][/color] not the cheerleading team! We're like... Babes in bikinis with baked goods!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Right...
A regime under Nicole is definitely social...
But not that spirited!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I mean, her car wash event was kind of disastrous!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, we made `some` money, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, we made [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] money, right?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I pick Nicole!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yes! Yes! Yes!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I knew this day would come! I knew it! I'm Head Cheerleader, and there's nothing you can do to stop me!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Why'd you pick her, Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: That's not why I signed up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, maybe I think it's important. We could use a more guy-centric viewpoint on the team. After all, guys are your biggest fans! So Keith feels the most qualified.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's time the cheerleading team diversified, and Keith's a good start!
